note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026), Curacao, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahwealj992) and average post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in ANG of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. ANG has since been replaced by XCG: the figures are carried into XCG at the issuer's fixed rate, 1 ANG to one XCG, the Centrale Bank van Curaçao en Sint Maarten's rate for the Caribbean guilder, legal tender from 31 March 2025, of one Netherlands Antillean guilder to one Caribbean guilder (its FAQ on caribbean-guilder.com; centralbank.cw itself answered with a Cloudflare check and was not read). Read 2026-10-30.
